title: File:Santa Claus - Sunkist Ad (1928).jpg
desc:
From the Boston Public Library.
It is Santa promoting lemons by Sunkist while holding a large sack, presumably full of lemons. It states Limoneira Company on the sack.

1 print : lithograph, color ; 8.75 x 12.75 in.
